market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $95 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$103 on May 5, needs to dip to $95 (~8% drop) anytime in May. Currently elevated by Iran/Hormuz risk premium. If ceasefire holds and Strait reopens, oil could de-rate quickly toward fundamentals (mid-$90s). 26 days left provides ample time for normalization.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Geopolitical resolution timing — if escalation continues, low could stay above $100
